question: Does a Samar State University research-repository record resolve the earlier Ulot River Ludong identification and provide an app-ready fish record?

source.title: Population Parameters of River Mullet ‘Ludong’ (Cestraeus sp.) in Ulot River, Paranas, Samar, Philippines
source.provider: Samar State University, as cited by a public Gov-AIdeaS mirror; the cited SSU-hosted canonical URL was not directly retrievable in this review

access.status: Search-indexed public metadata and a truncated abstract were reviewed on the Gov-AIdeaS mirror. The record labels the output 2025 and shows a 24 February 2026 publication/update date; the complete research details and 42.8 MB file require account registration according to the page. The canonical gov-aideas.ssu.edu.ph link shown by the mirror could not be opened, and a direct HEAD request failed TLS negotiation. No account was created and no gated file was requested or downloaded.

visibleMetadataClaims.methodAsReported: Length-frequency data analyzed using FAO-ICLARM Stock Assessment Tools (FiSAT)
visibleMetadataClaims.selectedAbstractClaims: The indexed abstract excerpt reports K = 0.23 yr-1, F = 1.60 yr-1 and E = 0.53, plus annual recruitment peaks and concern about capture of immature fish. These are source-reported abstract claims only; the underlying analysis and its applicability were not independently checked.
visibleMetadataClaims.dateAsDisplayed: 2025 research output; mirror page lists published and updated 2026-02-24

source.decision: Retain as a low-confidence bibliographic retrieval lead. The mirror's SSU citation and canonical SSU URL are not a verified copy of the official-hosted record. Do not treat its truncated abstract as a validated stock assessment, fish occurrence event, population estimate, harvest rule, or conservation/legal advisory.

crosswalk.relationshipDecision: The 2025 repository title overlaps the 2023 Samar Island Natural Park stock-assessment conference abstracts and names Ulot River, but the accessible metadata does not establish whether it is a final report, a separate study, or the same project output. It reports Cestraeus only to genus, so it does not resolve PID 2812's Cestraeus sp. versus PID 5194's Cestraeus plicatilis label. No voucher, sequence, station, or sample crosswalk is exposed.
crosswalk.freshwaterScope: Ulot River is the named setting, but sampling reach, salinity/tidal context, stations, dates, gear/effort, size table, and sample provenance are not visible. Keep any reach-level freshwater classification unresolved.
crosswalk.inventoryReadiness: No complete fish checklist or species-by-site dataset is exposed. The single genus-level taxon label does not represent a validated inventory.
crosswalk.reuse: No item-specific reuse license or permission was identified for the report, metadata, abstract, or derived data. Retain bibliographic facts and short source-bounded notes only.

disposition.reason: Only a mirrored metadata record and truncated abstract were inspectable. The SSU host, full methods/results, site/station and voucher crosswalk, and reuse conditions remain unverified.

nextActions: Check the cited gov-aideas.ssu.edu.ph record through an independently verifiable Samar State University route when accessible; confirm the repository host, full author names, output date, and file version without creating an account or crossing an access gate.

If an openly accessible final report becomes available, compare its sampling design, dates, sites, taxonomic determinations, vouchers, length-frequency data, uncertainty, and reuse terms with the 2023 MSDI PID 2812/PID 5194 abstracts before resolving any Ludong name or population claim.
Continue the Eastern Visayas freshwater sweep with another independently inspectable waterbody record; do not mark Samar or Eastern Visayas complete based on this metadata lead.

sources.supports: Search-indexed metadata and truncated abstract for the 2025 research output; page cites a gov-aideas.ssu.edu.ph canonical record and lists a 24 February 2026 publication/update date, but the SSU host and full text were not independently retrieved.
Existing Samar SINP crosswalk: PID 2812 reports Cestraeus sp.; PID 5194 reports Cestraeus plicatilis and Ulot/Basey wording. Used only to flag unresolved overlap and taxonomic conflict.
